facts.text: The Patriot Promise program covers the cost of all tuition and fees during the first year for freshmen who are South Carolina residents with demonstrated financial need.

sources.title: An Exceptional Journey at FMU - Francis Marion University
sources.quote: The Patriot Promise program makes it possible for all freshman who are South Carolina residents, and have demonstrated financial need, to cover the cost of all tuition and fees during their first year at FMU.
